text:
Lia: Quick question about variant fallback behavior in Console experiment setup — need to confirm how traffic gets rebalanced when a variant is disabled by a guard.
Kevin: Are we talking about *auto-redistribute* vs *pin-to-control*? Console currently supports both but UI defaults to auto-redistribute for canaries.
Lia: Right. Product wants a safer default for production experiments. Can we make the default pin-to-control but keep auto-redistribute opt-in? @Kevin
Kevin: We can. Implementation detail: routing layer has a flag on the ExperimentSpec -> fallback_policy: ["redistribute","pin_control"]
Marta: If we pin-to-control we need a quota guard so control doesn't get overloaded. Suggest a soft quota by concurrent requests or qps per variant.
Jason: Also need telemetry. When fallback happens we should emit events: experiment.fallback.reason, experiment.fallback.from_variant, experiment.fallback.to_variant, and metric impacts like experiment.latency.p50_delta
Priya: UX question — how do we show this in Console? A small banner on the experiment overview: "Fallback engaged — traffic pinned to control due to X" with a link to the audit log.
Lia: Good. Also we need a simulated preview in the editor: show expected split after fallback and expected service load.
Kevin: Implementation sketch:
```
{ "experiment_id": "exp_123", "variants": [{"id":"A","weight":90},{"id":"B","weight":10}], "fallback_policy": "pin_control", "quota": {"control_max_qps": 200}}
```
When B is disabled the router sets all B matches to A? No, to control variant id = A? Clarify names.
Marta: For us Control is a dedicated variant with id `control`. If B disabled and fallback=pin_control -> route to `control`. If fallback=redistribute -> redistributed proportionally across remaining non-disabled variants.
Jason: We should also avoid redistributing if the only remaining variant is `control` and control has < 2x capacity. add a safety guard that refuses redistribute and prefers pin_control.
deploy-bot: deploy-checker: Experiment exp_123 preflight: canary_policy missing quota guard -> warning :warning:
Priya: For Console, add a toggle next to fallback_policy: "Prefer pin-to-control (safer)" with tooltip explaining quota/telemetry requirements.
Lia: Action items: 1) @Kevin add fallback_policy enum + router behavior; 2) @Marta design soft quota enforcement and failure modes; 3) @Jason enumerate telemetry events + dashboard widgets; 4) @Priya mock UX copy + preview flow. I'll collect PRs and sync next Thurs.
Kevin: I'll open a draft PR for the API and router changes.
Marta: I'll prototype quota check to return `ok | rate_limited | capacity_unknown`.
Jason: I'll add metrics and a Grafana panel proposal.
Priya: I'll push a Console mock by EOD Friday.
Lia: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
